items.title: Unchecked Return Value Vulnerability in Google Brotli (Broccoli2Shell/HTTP2Shell/Node2Shell)
items.summary: This vulnerability in Google Brotli, impacting Adobe Commerce, allows a remote unauthenticated attacker to corrupt memory, disclose sensitive information, cause denial-of-service, or potentially execute arbitrary code. It has been added to CISA's KEV catalog, indicating active exploitation.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce (includes CVE-2026-103849)
items.summary: This update addresses multiple vulnerabilities, including critical, high, and medium severity issues that could lead to arbitrary code execution, privilege escalation, arbitrary file system write, and security feature bypass. The most critical issue, CVE-2026-103849 (BlockStrap), is a template engine injection with a CVSS score of 10.0.

items.title: BlockStrap: Magento and Adobe Commerce RCE Flaw
items.summary: BlockStrap is a critical (CVSS 10.0) template engine injection vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to achieve remote code execution in Magento and Adobe Commerce. While Adobe released a fix in APSB26-153, new installations may still be vulnerable without a manual patch.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce
items.summary: This security update resolves critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities in Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source. Successful exploitation could result in security feature bypass and privilege escalation.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce (includes CVE-2026-75650)
items.summary: This update resolves a critical vulnerability, CVE-2026-75650 (StyleSmuggler), that could result in arbitrary code execution in Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source. Adobe is aware that this CVE is being actively exploited in the wild.

items.title: StyleSmuggler: Magento and Adobe Commerce 0-day RCE
items.summary: Sansec discovered StyleSmuggler, a zero-day vulnerability allowing unauthenticated attackers remote code execution in Magento and Adobe Commerce, with attacks observed starting September 4th. Adobe released an emergency hotfix for this CVSS 10.0 flaw.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce
items.summary: This security update addresses critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities in Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source. Successful exploitation could lead to security feature bypass, arbitrary code execution, and privilege escalation.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce, Magento Open Source and Adobe Commerce Webhooks Plugin (includes CVE-2024-34102)
items.summary: This update resolves critical and important vulnerabilities, including CVE-2024-34102, which has been exploited in the wild in limited attacks. Successful exploitation could lead to arbitrary code execution, security feature bypass, and privilege escalation.

items.title: PolyShell: Adobe Commerce RCE Vulnerability (Unrestricted File Upload)
items.summary: This critical remote code execution vulnerability in Adobe Commerce is caused by an unrestricted upload of a file with dangerous types. Attackers can execute arbitrary code by uploading malicious files, and it has been added to CISA's KEV catalog due to active exploitation.
